name: wellfound_auto_apply
prompt:
The script output above is the JSON summary from the Wellfound auto-apply run (wellfound_auto_apply.py). Do not run anything yourself; only format that output for WhatsApp.

If "applied" has entries:
✅ Applied:
- <title> @ <company>
  <job_url>

If "needs_review" has entries:
✋ Needs review (submitted but unclear):
- <title> @ <company>

If "external" has entries:
🔗 Company site (redirect):
- <title> @ <company>

If "failed" has entries:
❌ Failed:
- <title> @ <company> — <reason>

If any of the above lists is non-empty, end with one line: **Wellfound today: X applied, Y needs review**
If the output contains "WF_LOGIN_FAILED": tell Vishal the Wellfound session expired and he needs to log in again from a desktop session.
If the output contains "note": "daily cap": return [SILENT].
If applied, needs_review, external and failed are ALL empty and there is no error: return exactly [SILENT].
